latest_release.body:
<!-- Optional: add a release summary here -->

## For more information read
https://maven.apache.org/docs/3.10.1/release-notes.html

## 🚀 New features and improvements

- [maven-3.10.x] Replace the 3.10 MessageBuilderFactory with the Maven 4 API (#13919) @slachiewicz
- Drop JLine, emit ANSI colors directly (#13888) @cstamas
- [3.10.x] Accept the ? optional-profile prefix in -P (#13480) @slachiewicz

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- [maven-3.10.x] Replace the 3.10 MessageBuilderFactory with the Maven 4 API (#13919) @slachiewicz
- Fix recursion detection for custom rootDirectory aliases (#13891) @goutamadwant
- Fix #13883: Do not shadow a custom rootDirectory property (#13885) @slawekjaranowski
- [3.10.x] Wait for terminal installation before caching logging output (#13799) @goutamadwant
- Fix #13726: add JAnsi compatibility shim to maven-jline and narrow jansi exports in extension.xml (#13727) @arturobernalg
- [Backport maven-3.10.x] Do not store the default current project in threads that only read it (#13803) @gnodet
- Read jar resources without the JVM jar: cache (#13737) @slachiewicz
- [Backport maven-3.10.x] Fix DependencyResolutionResult not dispatched when resolution fails (fix #8635) (#13688) @gnodet
- [maven-3.10.x] Resolve multiModuleProjectDirectory lexically instead of canonically (fix #11167) (#13650) (#13674) @gnodet
- [Backport maven-3.10.x] Honour the full interpolation flag for profile activation of low validation level builds (fix #13347) (#13571) @arturobernalg
- [Backport maven-3.10.x] Keep the zero between hyphens in the canonical form of a version (fix #8873) (#13572) @arturobernalg
- [Backport maven-3.10.x] fix: error == null to error != null in isError (#13595) @arturobernalg
- [Backport maven-3.10.x] [[MNG-8056]](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-8056) - Fix -f/-s parameters failing with absolute Cygwin paths (fix #10810) (#13593) @arturobernalg
- Read the password to encrypt from the standard input when there is no console (fix #10230) (#13589) @arturobernalg
- fix: JSR330 filtering fix (#13582) @cstamas
- [Backport maven-3.10.x] Report an invalid parent of an attached artifact instead of a NullPointerException (fix #8393) (#13575) @arturobernalg
- [Backport maven-3.10.x] [[MNG-8092]](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/MNG-8092) - Only warn about extension in reactor for projects actually built (fix #10859) (#13580) @arturobernalg
- [3.10.x] Accept the ? optional-profile prefix in -P (#13480) @slachiewicz
- [3.10.x] Fix gh-11618: Make DefaultModelValidator thread-safe (#13303) @abhu85
- [Backport maven-3.10.x] Keep the progress number of a project that is built again (fix #10291) (#13579) @arturobernalg
- [Backport maven-3.10.x] fix: honour quotes in MAVEN_ARGS in bin/mvn (fix #13413) (#13553) @gnodet
- Treat all loopback hosts as local for external mirror rules (fix #8320) (#13526) @gnodet
- [3.10.x] Fix #13390: stop POM properties from self-activating profiles in external builds (#13451) @gnodet
- [Backport 3.10.x] fix: print usage when no goals and no POM are specified, improve -f error messages (#13511) @gnodet
- [Backport 3.10.x] Evaluate expressions without a mojo execution (fix #8052) (#13505) @arturobernalg
- Verify the cygpath on the PATH converts to usable Windows paths (#13429) @choksi2212
- fix: accept documented lowercase values for maven.resolver.validation (#13474) @gnodet
- Fix settings interpolation with double-hyphen paths (#13399) @arturobernalg
- Honour --color in embedded MavenCli.doMain (#13358) @slachiewicz

## 📝 Documentation updates

- Fix link in default-bindings.md.vm (#13841) @slawekjaranowski
- Remove the Maven 2 era design notes from the maven-core site (#13771) @slachiewicz

## 👻 Maintenance

- Remove JLine/JAnsi native-access workarounds from launcher scripts (#13926) @slawekjaranowski
- chore: plugin updates (#13887) @cstamas
- Use push for PR Automation (#13610) @slawekjaranowski
- Add PR Signal workflow (#13599) @slawek

============

[![Reproducible Builds](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jvm-repo-rebuild/reproducible-central/master/content/org/apache/maven/maven/badge.json)](https://github.com/jvm-repo-rebuild/reproducible-central/blob/master/content/org/apache/maven/maven/README.md)

- [master](https://github.com/apache/maven) = 4.1.x
[![Jenkins Build](https://img.shields.io/jenkins/build?jobUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fci-maven.apache.org%2Fjob%2FMaven%2Fjob%2Fmaven-box%2Fjob%2Fmaven%2Fjob%2Fmaster%2F)][build]

[![Java CI](https://github.com/apache/maven/actions/workflows/maven.yml/badge.svg?branch=maven-3.9.x)][gh-build-3.9]

Apache Maven is a software project management and comprehension tool. Based on
the concept of a project object model (POM), Maven can manage a project's
build, reporting and documentation from a central piece of information.

If you think you have found a bug, please file an issue in the [Maven Issue Tracker](https://github.com/apache/maven/issues).

Documentation
-------------

More information can be found on [Apache Maven Homepage][maven-home].
Questions related to the usage of Maven should be posted on
the [Maven User List][users-list].


Where can I get the latest release?
-----------------------------------
You can download the release source from our [download page][maven-download].

Contributing
------------

If you are interested in the development of Maven, please consult the
documentation first and afterward you are welcome to join the developers
mailing list to ask questions or discuss new ideas/features/bugs etc.

Take a look into the [contribution guidelines](CONTRIBUTING.md).

License
-------
This code is under the [Apache License, Version 2.0, January 2004][license].

See the [`NOTICE`](./NOTICE) file for required notices and attributions.

Donations
---------
Do you like Apache Maven? Then [donate back to the ASF](https://www.apache.org/foundation/contributing.html) to support the development.

Quick Build
-------
If you want to bootstrap Maven, you'll need:
- Java 17+
- Maven 3.9.0 or later
- Run Maven, specifying a location into which the completed Maven distro should be installed:
    ```
    mvn -DdistributionTargetDir="$HOME/app/maven/apache-maven-4.1.x-SNAPSHOT" clean package
    ```
